verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a public REST API with token-based auth (a global token for managing anything in Better Stack, plus team-scoped Uptime tokens) using a standard Bearer header. It also has a per-endpoint reference covering monitor create, update and delete, with copyable curl examples, filters and paginated JSON responses, and the docs mention Terraform for automation. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths return 404), endpoint evidence beyond the Uptime API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: A global API token is a token valid across all your teams, for managing anything within Better Stack.
Simply include an `Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN` header in your requests.
Create monitor POST ... Update monitor PATCH ... Remove monitor DELETE
Per-endpoint Uptime API reference ("List monitors") with copyable request examples per endpoint
Automate your workflows and integrate Better Stack with your existing tools using our APIs and protocols.
